title: Desktop UI full player journey on the merged candidate served by the packaged sidecar

host_boundary.what_this_is: The desktop Vue UI (vite build with VITE_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/v2) driven in the ZCode in-app browser, talking to the packaged sidecar bundled inside DZMM.app (same binary the .app spawned on 127.0.0.1:8765).
host_boundary.what_this_is_not: This is NOT the Tauri window itself. The packaged-window walkthrough remains blocked by ZCode's macOS Accessibility/Screen Recording TCC grants (see phase196); grant them and rerun to close that last shell-level check.
host_boundary.why_this_counts_toward_the_gate: frontend bundle + packaged backend + real model + real local SQLite are all the merged candidate; the only untested layer is the Tauri shell chrome, which phase193 already demonstrated and which has no Wave1 code changes (desktop/src untouched by Wave1 merges except user's local style.css).
